info.name: Looking for the Wiseman in Perion
info.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

descriptions.inProgress: I handed Scadur the wolf skins he asked for, and he gave me back the #bold ring#k. He reminisced the old days where heard about the ring through the four wisemen he had met as a young man. He recommended me to go visit Victoria Island and meet up with all four of the wisemen, starting with the one in #bPerion#k.
